dutyCycle: Each truck's duty cycle is classified automatically from its last 90 days in Samsara (MPG including idle, idle %, annual miles) using each manufacturer's rules; the default column is Detroit Long Haul / Cummins Normal / Freightliner Schedule II / PACCAR On Highway
notes: Intervals are 'whichever comes first'. Miles are statute miles. Sources are linked per schedule. Verify against the manual before relying on an interval.

settings.label: Detroit-approved engine oil
settings.description: Approved oils say DFS 93K222 or 93K223 on the jug or data sheet (e.g. approved versions of Shell Rotella T4, Mobil Delvac 1300 Super). Generic: oil change intervals are cut in half, a conservative assumption since Detroit only says 'reduced'; confirm with your dealer.
settings.question: Engine oil in Detroit engines

settings.label: Frame-mounted fuel filter
settings.description: Detroit fuel filter / water separator or Davco 385/482/485/487 on the frame rail. No: the engine fuel filter is changed at every oil change.
settings.question: Frame-mounted fuel filter on Detroit trucks

settings.label: Extended-life coolant
settings.description: Standard-life coolant is tested at every oil change interval and replaced every 300,000 mi.
settings.question: Coolant in Detroit engines

settings.label: Valvoline Premium Blue oil
settings.description: Cummins adds 5,000 mi to X15 oil change intervals with Valvoline Premium Blue.
settings.question: Oil in Cummins X15 engines

cummins.label: Cummins duty cycle
cummins.idleRule: If idle + PTO time is over 40%, Light, Normal and Short Haul drop to the next lower duty cycle
